changelog.note: modell-adminisztráció kiszervezése a jav/config.py konstansaiból: azonosítók, árak, timeout, cache-verzió
Jev keret-kör 1 (BACKLOG 1): cache_version 2 (a konkrét modellverzió a cache-kulcsban, egyszeri érvénytelenítés), alias_ttl_hours, explicit retry (typesafe_sdk.RetryPolicy mezői)
tipus-csomagok: Burr tracker-projekt az invoice_foreign csomagnak (jav_invoice_foreign) es alapertelmezes (invoice -> jav_invoice) a tovabbi csomagoknak
075 (repeated security audit, S02): openai.sdk_max_retries = 0 - the OpenAI client's own transport retries were paid requests outside the reservation; the work queue repeats a failed item instead

075 (repeated security audit, S01; Azure recipe switch): azure_di.usd_per_page for the up-front reservation and the call log; here and not in configs/ocr.json, whose hash is part of every OCR cache key

200 (the owner's decision of 2026-10-22): jev.model pinned to jev-1.14.0, the version the moving name jev-latest resolved to since 2026-10-22 05:17 UTC (its answers and cache keys are unchanged); jev.watch_alias = jev-latest, only looked at (the daily backup, jav/jev_version.py), so a newer version is reported and taken only by a decision with a measurement.

jev.note: 200: pinned to a concrete version (docs.typesafe.ai/models: versioned IDs are accepted; pin when thresholds are tuned against a version). The moving name jev-latest is only resolved by the daily look (runs/cache/_model_versions.json); jev-1.13.0 answered until 2026-10-22, its limits: docs.typesafe.ai/model-jaggedness/jev-1.13.md

retry._note: typesafe_sdk.RetryPolicy mezői; a http_statuses alapból 408/429/5xx; timeout = teljes keret egy SDK-hívásra (nagyobb, mint a timeout_s kérés-limit)

openai.note: G-kar generatív kivonat (Pydantic AI); a régi sidecar-beállítás: reasoning none, temperature 0

azure_di.note: list price of Azure Document Intelligence prebuilt-read (1.50 USD / 1000 pages); an assumption: the legacy sidecar's subscription tier is not known
